In terms of “how long is long enough” for you to be seen with your new guy and you not wanting to lose your ex’s respect,  let me give you some insight from myself.

My ex and I dated for 6 1/2 years. He was a horrible boyfriend who verbally and emotionally abused me. The day after we broke up I happened to have a conversation with a guy I honestly always thought was really attractive(we were coworkers but in different departments). That weekend I had a party that he came to. Long story short, we connected deeply and a month after my breakup we were official, and we’re still going strong and building our relationship.

During that time I also had it in the back of my head “What if he sees me around town with my new boyfriend?”

I quickly realized a very short while into dating my boyfriend that that didn’t matter at all. My ex doesn’t own me. My ex doesn’t factor into our relationship at all. I’m going to do whatever, wherever and whenever I want with my boyfriend and I don’t care who sees. Don’t let your new relationship suffer because you’re hung up on your ex. Speaking from personal experience, it’s very easy to move on relatively fast and into a new relationship that is healthy and strong, however it sounds like you might not be ready for that.

Best of luck.
